ask_wyvstudio_assistant.open_world_justification: It works only inside the user's own WyvStudio workspace, through the authenticated WyvStudio API: it posts nothing, creates no public link and fetches no outside web page. Any AI it uses is a provider WyvStudio calls on its own behalf; nothing is sent to a third party for the user to see.
ask_wyvstudio_assistant.destructive_justification: Nothing in the video changes; it only adds turns to the assistant chat.

cancel_operation.read_only_justification: Stops a paid operation that is still running and releases the credits not yet used.
cancel_operation.open_world_justification: It works only inside the user's own WyvStudio workspace, through the authenticated WyvStudio API: it posts nothing, creates no public link and fetches no outside web page.
cancel_operation.destructive_justification: Marked destructive because a cancelled operation cannot be resumed: the work that had not finished is dropped.

update_character.read_only_justification: Changes a character's name, description or reference photos in the user's workspace.
update_character.open_world_justification: It works only inside the user's own WyvStudio workspace, through the authenticated WyvStudio API: it posts nothing, creates no public link and fetches no outside web page.
update_character.destructive_justification: Marked destructive because it overwrites the character's details and keeps no history, so the old values cannot be restored from WyvStudio.

share_video.read_only_justification: Turns a video's public share link on or off.
share_video.open_world_justification: It creates a public link anyone with the URL can open, outside WyvStudio.
share_video.destructive_justification: Sharing can be turned off again with the same tool (enabled: false); nothing is deleted.

weave_share.read_only_justification: Turns a Create video's public share link on or off and keeps the finished video in the user's library.
weave_share.open_world_justification: It creates a public link anyone with the URL can open, outside WyvStudio.
weave_share.destructive_justification: Sharing can be turned off again with the same tool; nothing is deleted.

publish_video.read_only_justification: Posts, or schedules, a video on a social account the user connected, and records the post in their workspace.
publish_video.open_world_justification: It posts to the user's YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or Facebook account, so the effect lands outside WyvStudio on a public platform.
publish_video.destructive_justification: Marked destructive because a post that has gone live cannot be recalled through this connector. It refuses without confirm: true, after the user has approved the account, the caption and the time.
